description: This file defines classes and interfaces related to an AI service configuration and implementation, including options for different providers, and a service class that generates remediation instructions based on vulnerability summaries.

classes.name: AiOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for the AI service, including provider, system prompt, max output tokens, and specific options for Ollama.

classes.name: OllamaOptions
classes.description: Configuration options specific to the Ollama AI provider, including base URL and model name.

classes.name: AiService
classes.description: Implementation of IAiService that generates remediation instructions by interfacing with different AI providers based on configuration.

methods.name: GenerateRemediationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously generates remediation instructions given a vulnerability summary by invoking the configured AI provider.
